risk: Credit decisions are influenced by relationship pressure or incentive targets, so exceptions to policy become routine rather than exceptional.
audit_objective: Assess whether credit policy exceptions are genuinely exceptional, escalated to the right level, and performing no worse than compliant lending.
what_to_review: Policy exception rate by product, branch and originator
Level at which exceptions are approved
Performance of exception loans versus the book
Incentive structures for lending staff
Override of automated credit scores
procedures: Extract all loans booked with a policy exception; analyse rate by originator, branch and product against the portfolio average.
Test that each exception was approved at the level the policy requires, not one below.
Compare arrears and default rates of exception loans to compliant loans of the same vintage.
Review the incentive plan for lending staff and test whether volume targets dominate credit quality measures.
Investigate cases where an automated score was manually overridden and trace the justification.
red_flags: Exceptions concentrated with a small number of originators
Exceptions approved by the originator's immediate manager only
Rising exception rate near quarter end
Overrides without recorded justification
evidence: Credit policy and delegated authority matrix
Arrears and default data by vintage

risk: Customer due diligence is incomplete or out of date, and transaction monitoring alerts are closed without adequate investigation, exposing the bank to regulatory enforcement.
audit_objective: Determine whether customer due diligence, screening and transaction monitoring operate as designed and that alerts are investigated to a defensible standard.
what_to_review: CDD and enhanced due diligence completeness at onboarding
Periodic review cycle for existing customers, especially high risk
Sanctions and PEP screening coverage and tuning
Transaction monitoring alert backlog and closure quality
Suspicious activity report timeliness and quality
procedures: Sample customer files across risk ratings and test CDD completeness against policy, including source of funds for high-risk customers.
Quantify overdue periodic reviews by risk rating and test whether relationships continued to transact.
Re-perform screening on a sample of customers and counterparties to confirm the system produces the expected hits.
Sample closed monitoring alerts and reassess whether the closure rationale is supportable; measure closure rate by analyst.
Test elapsed time from alert to suspicious activity report filing against the regulatory deadline.
red_flags: A single analyst closing far more alerts than peers
Alerts closed with template narratives
Screening rules relaxed after a volume spike
High-risk customers overdue for review still transacting
evidence: Screening system configuration and tuning records
kpis: Days from alert to SAR filing

risk: Claims are settled for more than the policy requires because coverage is not properly applied, subrogation is not pursued and reserves anchor the settlement.
audit_objective: Quantify claims leakage and identify where in the handling process value is lost.
what_to_review: Coverage verification before settlement
Reserve setting discipline and reserve movement patterns
Subrogation and recovery identification
Use of preferred suppliers and negotiated rates
Settlement authority adherence
procedures: Re-review a sample of closed claims against policy wording and quantify amounts paid above entitlement.
Analyse reserve movements: claims settled at or near the initial reserve may indicate anchoring rather than assessment.
Identify closed claims with third-party liability indicators and test whether subrogation was pursued.
Compare settlement values by handler and by supplier for similar claim types.
red_flags: Settlements clustered just below authority limits
Claims closed with no subrogation review
A handler consistently settling above peer averages
Repeat claimants across policies
evidence: Claims system extract with reserve history

risk: Business is written through intermediaries who are not authorised, whose commissions are calculated incorrectly, or who mis-sell products to unsuitable customers.
audit_objective: Confirm intermediaries are properly appointed and monitored, and that commission and conduct risks are controlled.
what_to_review: Intermediary appointment, licensing and vetting
Commission calculation and payment accuracy
Product suitability and sales conduct monitoring
Premium collection and client money handling by intermediaries
Complaint and cancellation patterns by intermediary
procedures: Reconcile intermediaries paid commission to the approved and licensed intermediary register.
Recompute commission for a sample of policies against the agency agreement and test clawback on early cancellation.
Analyse lapse, cancellation and complaint rates by intermediary and investigate the outlier tail.
Test premium remittance timeliness against the agency agreement and quantify amounts held beyond terms.
red_flags: Commission paid to intermediaries with lapsed licences
High early-cancellation rates concentrated with one agent
Premium remitted late or netted against commission
Policies written for customers outside the target market

risk: Actual production yield falls below standard and the loss is absorbed in variances rather than investigated, masking equipment, material or process failure.
audit_objective: Evaluate whether yield and scrap losses are measured accurately at the line level and driven down through root-cause action.
what_to_review: Yield and scrap reporting accuracy at each production stage
Rework classification and cost capture
Root-cause analysis on repeat losses
Machine downtime capture and maintenance linkage
Bill of materials accuracy versus actual consumption
procedures: Reconcile material issued to output produced plus scrap for a sample of production orders; investigate unexplained gaps.
Compare reported yield by line and shift; test whether the reporting is system-generated or manually entered.
Trace repeat scrap causes through to a corrective action with a verified closure.
Compare bill of materials quantities to actual consumption for high-volume products.
red_flags: Yield reported identically period after period
Scrap recorded in bulk at month end
Rework not distinguished from first-pass output
Downtime attributed to a generic category

risk: Safety incidents are under-reported and environmental permit conditions are breached, exposing the company to enforcement, shutdown and reputational damage.
audit_objective: Assess whether safety and environmental obligations are identified, monitored and actually met at plant level.
what_to_review: Permit inventory and condition tracking
Incident and near-miss reporting culture
Corrective action closure after incidents
Emissions, effluent and waste monitoring and reporting
Contractor safety management on site
procedures: Build an inventory of environmental permits and test compliance with each material condition, including monitoring and reporting deadlines.
Compare reported incident rates across plants; a plant with an implausibly low rate warrants interview-based testing.
Trace a sample of incidents to root-cause analysis and verify the corrective action was implemented, not just recorded.
Test contractor induction, permit-to-work and competency records for work performed on site.
red_flags: Near-miss reporting falling while incidents hold steady
Corrective actions closed with no evidence
Monitoring results clustered just inside the permit limit
Contractors working without a permit to work

risk: Store staff generate refunds, voids or discounts against genuine sales and remove the cash, or apply staff discounts to customer transactions.
audit_objective: Identify cash losses arising from transaction manipulation at the point of sale and test whether monitoring detects them.
what_to_review: Refund, void and no-sale authorisation at the till
Refunds without an original receipt or card match
Staff discount usage patterns
Till variance investigation thresholds
CCTV coverage over till points
procedures: Analyse refunds by cashier per hundred transactions and rank stores and operators; select the outlier tail for CCTV review.
Test refunds processed to a different payment method than the original sale.
Match staff discount transactions to employee purchase records and test for use on non-employee sales.
Test whether till variances below the investigation threshold accumulate to a material amount by operator.
red_flags: Refunds concentrated in the operator's own shift with no customer present on CCTV
Repeated small variances just under the threshold
Voids immediately after a cash sale
Discount cards used at multiple stores

risk: Suppliers under-deliver, deliver late or invoice outside agreed terms, and the store network absorbs the loss because claims are never raised.
audit_objective: Confirm that goods received match what was ordered and invoiced, and that supplier non-compliance is claimed and recovered.
what_to_review: Three-way match discipline between order, receipt and invoice
Short and damaged delivery claim process
On-time in-full performance by supplier
Price differences between contract and invoice
Deduction and chargeback recovery
procedures: Quantify receipts posted without a purchase order and invoices paid without a matched receipt.
Re-price a sample of invoices against contracted terms and quantify overcharges.
Analyse on-time in-full performance by supplier and test whether contractual service credits were claimed.
Test the ageing of open supplier claims and the recovery rate.
red_flags: Receipts booked in full despite recorded shortages
Claims raised but never followed up
Price variances always in the supplier's favour
A supplier consistently below service level with no credits taken
evidence: Purchase order, receipt and invoice data

risk: Aircraft are released to service without all required maintenance tasks and airworthiness directives being completed and certified.
audit_objective: Confirm that maintenance is performed and certified by authorised personnel and that airworthiness records are complete and traceable.
what_to_review: Airworthiness directive and service bulletin compliance tracking
Certifying staff authorisation scope and currency
Deferred defect management against the minimum equipment list
Parts traceability and approved supply chain
Maintenance record retention and integrity
procedures: Select applicable airworthiness directives and trace each to a completed and certified work package within the required interval.
Test that certifying signatures belong to staff whose authorisation covers that aircraft type and task, and was current on the date.
Analyse deferred defects for items carried beyond the MEL time limit or repeatedly re-deferred.
Trace a sample of fitted parts to release certificates and approved suppliers.
red_flags: Defects repeatedly deferred and re-raised
Certification by staff whose authorisation lapsed
Parts fitted without an airworthiness release certificate
Records completed retrospectively in blocks

risk: Ground handling errors damage aircraft, delay departures and generate airline chargebacks that are absorbed rather than investigated.
audit_objective: Assess control over ramp operations, damage reporting and the recovery or prevention of associated cost.
what_to_review: Ground support equipment maintenance and operator licensing
Aircraft damage reporting and investigation
Delay coding accuracy and attribution
Load control and weight and balance accuracy
Airside driving permits and training currency
procedures: Reconcile ground damage incidents reported internally to airline claims received; investigate claims with no internal report.
Test operator licensing and training currency for a sample of ramp staff and equipment types.
Analyse delay codes attributed to handling and test the supporting evidence for a sample.
Review load sheet accuracy against actual loading for a sample of flights.
red_flags: Damage discovered by the airline rather than reported by the station
Delay codes reassigned after the fact
Equipment operated by staff without a current licence
Load sheets amended after departure
evidence: Ground damage register and airline claims
Load sheets and weight and balance records
